newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Human rallies on rating, mkt sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Human rallies on rating, mkt sentiment.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Human Rt gained more than four percent in early trading on Tuesday, benefiting partly from a brokerage recommendation on Monday.
Traders added, however, that the overall market sentiment was positive, therefore the market trend also contributed to Human's gains.
"I wouldn't say that the recommendation is the only reason behind Human's rise," one trader said.
At 0955 GMT Human shares traded at 3,000 forints, up 80 or 2.74 percent from Monday's close. The shares had earlier reached 3,050.
On Monday Bank Austria-Investment rated Human shares as "outperform" in a company report.
